material_changes: Keep the ordinary indefinite/classifying article as L1 but make the a/an sound boundary explicit.
Add the per-each rate use and the one-before-number/quantity use as live learner senses.
Promote high-frequency article/rate/quantity patterns into first-class constructions.

core_clusters.label_cn: 一个；某个；某类中的一个
core_clusters.label_en: one non-specific member of a class
one before a number or quantity expression

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 把一个对象作为“非特指的一个/一类成员”引入；也可表示每一单位或数量中的“一”
core_concept.core_meaning_en: introduces one non-specific member of a class; it also marks a per-unit rate or the value one in common quantity expressions
core_concept.mental_model_cn: 先把某个单数可数对象“引入场景”，而不是指双方已经知道的那个；在频率、价格和数量里又常读成“每/一”。
core_concept.mental_model_en: introduce one non-specific instance; in rate and quantity frames, read it as per/one

overrides.definition_cn: 用于单数可数名词前，引入一个非特指的人/物，或说明其身份、类别
overrides.definition_en: used before a singular count noun to introduce one non-specific person or thing or to classify what someone or something is
overrides.sense_label_en: one non-specific member or class label
overrides.usage_note: Use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound; the sound, not the first written letter, decides.

payload.definition_cn: 每；每一（表示频率、价格、速度等的单位）
payload.definition_en: for each or every unit, especially in rates, frequency, prices, or measurement
payload.sense_label_en: for each or every unit; per

payload.definition_cn: 一；一个（用于 hundred、thousand、dozen 等数量表达）
payload.definition_en: one, especially before common number or quantity expressions such as hundred, thousand, or dozen
payload.sense_label_en: one in a number or quantity expression

constructions.meaning_cn: 一个非特指的单数可数对象；a/an 由后接音决定
constructions.learning_note: a before a consonant sound; an before a vowel sound.

constructions.meaning_cn: 每……一次/若干次；按单位计

material_changes: Separate leaving a person/place/object from giving up a plan/activity while keeping both under the common 'leave completely' model.
Keep the useful fixed phrase with abandon learner-visible without promoting the rare free noun to an equal core sense.

core_clusters.label_en: leave a person, place, or thing behind completely
give up a plan, attempt, activity, or intention

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 彻底撤回原本的陪伴、占有、计划或投入
core_concept.core_meaning_en: to withdraw completely from a person, place, thing, plan, or course of action
core_concept.mental_model_cn: 不是暂时放一放，而是把原本的“继续维持/继续投入”彻底撤掉。
core_concept.mental_model_en: remove the commitment to keep staying with, supporting, possessing, or pursuing something

overrides.sense_label_en: leave someone or something behind completely
give up a plan, activity, or attempt

owners.fresh_acceptance_reason: Current object has the ordinary anatomical sense, useful lower-abdomen and abdominal-pain collocations, coherent active identity, and no misleading promoted branch.
